proposition.claim:
Weighted absolute moment controlled without source tail information

Smooth signed L1 equation, unit source norm, bounded drift, admissible psi. Gaussian is intended advertised operator after necessary per-order correction P3; no claim it satisfies impossible literal(K).

False scalar Gronwall inference

A>=0,J>=0 decreasing absolutely continuous J1=0; these are the displayed scalar premises. Not an MFG nonuniqueness example.

One finite constant for all derivative orders makes literal operator class empty

Any Levy semigroup with probability density and stated L1 derivative estimate; finite xi exponential never zero.

Exact representation norm false and chosen-lift Cauchy inference invalid

Composition inequality omits individual map Lipschitz norms

Forcing-independent time-derivative modulus false; alpha2 integral loses logarithm

Initial-time weight, mild-sign and arbitrary smoothing exponent corrections

repair.content:
Exploit actual m Gamma Dz+c source tails in Duhamel rather than stated false general bound.

Additional valid energy control or restrict H2; constant beta*u integrating factor does not cover general case.

K_beta or specified finite maximum derivative order; finite time horizon for anisotropic-minimum order.

Use dual maximum product norm; restrict representable functionals to(C0^n)*, HahnBanach/Riesz and scaled cutoffs give isometric onto map, hence completeness.

Correct composition/interpolation estimate with individual map bounds.

Include forcing time modulus; keep logarithmic endpoint or smaller spatial Holder exponent.

Use(t-t0)^gamma/alpha,f-H,and limited smoothing exponent.
